共用壳上的四台机器人Four robots on one shared shell

一个壳、四个卡座、两种腿：换腿的位置得到四台机器人。每页左边是装法，右边是它在仿真里走 20 秒。One shell, four docks, two kinds of leg: moving the legs gives four robots. Each tab shows the assembly (left) and a 20 s walk in simulation (right).
